text:
maria_cs: quick follow-up on LatticeCore: legal asked for a short MOU before we get cross-account CMK privileges and object-lock enabled. renewal call is in 2 weeks, so we need an ETA.

emily_latticecore: confirmed — security wants a one-page MOU outlining key access scope, retention window (24 months), and audit-only key usage. they provided the bucket name: latticecore-audit-archive and admin ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LatticeAuditAdmin. CMK: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1111-efgh-2222.

maria_cs: thanks. is that CMK customer-managed?

emily_latticecore: yes it's customer-managed in our account. we expect Redwood to use an assumed role to write objects and set retention.

sanjay_eng: tech checklist notes: 1) bucket must be created with Object Lock enabled and Versioning. that must be done at bucket creation time in their account. 2) exporter role needs sts:AssumeRole and s3:PutObject, s3:PutObjectRetention permissions. 3) CMK must allow kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt and kms:PutKeyPolicy if they want RW updates. 4) we need kms:PutObjectRetention on the CMK for setting retention metadata.

leo_sre: network side: peering + route table is fine with the approved egress IPs, but if they host bucket in same VPC we can use interface endpoints for S3 to avoid NAT. confirm whether they want traffic via peering or private link.

emily_latticecore: they'll use interface endpoint in their VPC. security likes that.

tony_legal: happy to produce a one-page MOU draft. I need two things from engineering to populate: exact principal (role ARN or service principal) and a short bullet describing what Redwood will and will not do with the key (e.g., "encrypt/decrypt only for audit export and archival; no key rotation without notice").

sanjay_eng: principal: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-audit-uploader-prod. We won't rotate customer CMKs; the customer manages rotation. ops will require a small runbook step if key metadata changes.

maria_cs: Tony — if you can draft the MOU by EOD tomorrow we'll share with LatticeCore legal. Also we'll note a potential small one-time engineering fee for enabling object-lock and runbook changes.

tony_legal: can do. I'll add limited scope language and a 30-day notice clause for any operational changes.

leo_sre: assignment: @sanjay_eng update runbook for cross-account upload (object-lock steps + exporter role) and estimate dev effort. @tony_legal draft MOU. @emily_latticecore provide confirmation that bucket creation with object-lock + versioning is scheduled. ops-bot: create ticket.

ops-bot: created issue RDW-4599: "LatticeCore: MOU + cross-account CMK & object-lock enablement" assigned to sanjay_eng, tony_legal. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RDW-4599

sanjay_eng: estimate: 1.5 engineer-days (runbook + tiny exporter change) + 0.5 day validation with customer. Also we'll need a billing flag for cold storage; ops should advise on chargeback.

maria_cs: good. Emily — any blockers from your side for bucket creation?

emily_latticecore: security says they'll create the bucket after they review Tony's MOU. target: bucket created and admin ARN shared by Thursday EOD. if MOU review drags it could slip a week.

maria_cs: noted — I'll mark renewal risk as "medium" until MOU signed. We'll update stakeholders Friday. Thanks everyone.

emily_latticecore: thanks all!"
